$comment: Canonical lane ownership for parallel agent work. Branch and task IDs must match PLAN.md section 5 (checked by tests/lanes.test.ts). A lane may edit only its `owns` globs plus its task note; package.json/package-lock.json edits are allowed but must be listed in the task note. Every other path is shared: change it only with integration-owner approval. Check a branch with `npm run lane:check`.

capture.title: Capture & reconstruction
capture.check: A real photo or Chert caller frame becomes a valid IngestEnvelope; a masked frame becomes a validated mesh job.

platform.title: Platform
platform.check: Sign in, save and reload a take from TigerData, ingest a frame over HTTP, and see a stale save rejected as a conflict.

editor.title: Editor
editor.check: Open the fixture manifest, select and transform the box with undo, fork a take, and switch back to the unchanged original.
